lyrics.ja: 未完成の地図を輝きに変えて
lyrics.romaji: Mikansei no Chizu wo Kagayaki ni Kaete
lyrics.en: Turn the incomplete map into radiance
lyrics.zh: 將未完成的地圖化為光芒

lyrics.ja: 誰にも真似できない足跡を見てて！
lyrics.romaji: Dare ni mo Mane Dekinai Ashiato wo Mitete!
lyrics.en: Watch the footprints no one else can imitate!
lyrics.zh: 看著這誰也無法模仿的足跡吧！

lyrics.ja: 走り出した願いは加速してフルスピード
lyrics.romaji: Hashiridashita Negai ha Kasoku Shite Furu Supiido
lyrics.en: The wish that started running accelerates to full speed
lyrics.zh: 起跑的願望加速奔馳，達到全速

lyrics.ja: 目に映るものに戸惑うなら
lyrics.romaji: Me ni Utsuru Mono ni Tomadou nara
lyrics.en: If you're bewildered by what you see
lyrics.zh: 如果你對眼前所見感到困惑

lyrics.ja: 仮想世界だって
lyrics.en: Even in a virtual world
lyrics.zh: 即使身處虛擬世界

lyrics.ja: 私が視えてるんでしょ？
lyrics.en: You can see me, right?
lyrics.zh: 你也能看見我吧？

lyrics.ja: キミだけに在る世界が正解
lyrics.romaji: Kimi dake ni Aru Sekai ga Seikai
lyrics.en: The world that exists only for you is the right answer
lyrics.zh: 只存在於你身上的世界才是正確答案

lyrics.ja: 時々は泣き出したくもなるよ
lyrics.romaji: Tokidoki ha Nakidashitaku mo Naru yo
lyrics.en: Sometimes I feel like bursting into tears
lyrics.zh: 有時也會忍不住想哭出來

lyrics.ja: だけどドキドキがクレッシェンド
lyrics.en: But this pounding heart is a crescendo
lyrics.zh: 但心跳的悸動宛如漸強樂章

lyrics.ja: 鳴り止まないから…
lyrics.en: Because it won't stop ringing...
lyrics.zh: 因為它不會停止鳴響……

lyrics.ja: 大きく歌って　立って
lyrics.en: Sing loudly and stand tall
lyrics.zh: 大聲歌唱，挺身而立

lyrics.ja: キミに届けたいよ
lyrics.en: I want it to reach you
lyrics.zh: 好想傳達給你

lyrics.ja: 素直になって　なって
lyrics.en: Become honest, become true
lyrics.zh: 變得坦率，再更坦率

lyrics.ja: 未来を見に行こうよ
lyrics.romaji: Mirai wo Mi ni Ikou yo
lyrics.en: Let's go see the future
lyrics.zh: 一起去看看未來吧

lyrics.ja: 明けない夜だって
lyrics.en: Even a night that never dawns
lyrics.zh: 即使是永不天明的黑夜

lyrics.ja: 光のない朝だって
lyrics.en: Even a morning without light
lyrics.zh: 即使是沒有光芒的早晨

lyrics.ja: 平気だよ　一緒に笑いたいから
lyrics.romaji: Heiki Da yo Issho ni Waraitai kara
lyrics.en: It's okay, because I want to laugh together with you
lyrics.zh: 都沒關係，因為我想和你一起歡笑

lyrics.ja: 綺麗になって　なって
lyrics.en: Become beautiful, become brighter
lyrics.zh: 讓自己變得更美，再更美

lyrics.ja: ちょびっと自信持って
lyrics.en: Have a little confidence
lyrics.zh: 擁有一點點自信

lyrics.ja: デタラメだって　だって
lyrics.en: Even if it's nonsense, even so
lyrics.zh: 就算是荒唐胡鬧，就算如此

lyrics.ja: ここで歌いたいの
lyrics.en: I want to sing right here
lyrics.zh: 我還是想在這裡歌唱

lyrics.ja: いつもよりもちょっと
lyrics.en: A little more than usual
lyrics.zh: 比平常再多一點

lyrics.ja: 大きな声でもっと
lyrics.en: With an even louder voice
lyrics.zh: 用更大的聲音，更加地

lyrics.ja: 怯んでも竦んでも　仕方ないよね
lyrics.romaji: Hirunde mo Sukunde mo Shikata Nai yo ne
lyrics.en: Even if I flinch or freeze, there's no helping it, right?
lyrics.zh: 就算退縮或僵住，也沒辦法吧

lyrics.ja: スポットライト
lyrics.en: Spotlight
lyrics.zh: 聚光燈

lyrics.ja: もうちょっと当ててきて　最高潮！
lyrics.en: Shine on me a little more—at full climax!
lyrics.zh: 再稍微照亮我吧，推向最高潮！

lyrics.ja: 不安も全部巻き込んで上がるステージで
lyrics.romaji: Fuan mo Zenbu Makikonde Agaru Suteeji de
lyrics.en: On a stage that rises and sweeps up all my anxiety
lyrics.zh: 在將不安全部捲入而升起的舞台上

lyrics.ja: おしとやかに立って
lyrics.en: Standing gracefully
lyrics.zh: 端莊優雅地站著

lyrics.ja: これが私のロックンロール
lyrics.en: This is my rock 'n' roll
lyrics.zh: 這就是我的搖滾樂

lyrics.ja: キミだけに見せたい答えの世界
lyrics.romaji: Kimi dake ni Misetai Kotae no Sekai
lyrics.en: A world of answers I want to show only to you
lyrics.zh: 只想讓你看見的答案世界

lyrics.ja: 今日だけは一緒に泣いてもいいよ
lyrics.romaji: Kyou dake ha Issho ni Naite mo Ii yo
lyrics.en: Just for today, it's okay to cry together
lyrics.zh: 只有今天，一起哭泣也沒關係

lyrics.ja: だけど明日って字は明るい日と書くんだよ
lyrics.romaji: Dakedo Ashita tte Ji ha Akarui Hi to Kaku n Da yo
lyrics.en: But the word 'tomorrow' is written with the characters for 'bright day,' you know
lyrics.zh: 但「明天」這兩個字，寫作「明亮的日子」喔

lyrics.ja: 知ってた？
lyrics.en: Did you know?
lyrics.zh: 你知道嗎？

lyrics.ja: 大きく歌って　立って
lyrics.en: Sing loudly and stand tall
lyrics.zh: 大聲歌唱，挺身而立

lyrics.ja: キミに届けたいよ
lyrics.en: I want it to reach you
lyrics.zh: 好想傳達給你

lyrics.ja: 素直になって　なって
lyrics.en: Become honest, become true
lyrics.zh: 變得坦率，再更坦率

lyrics.ja: 未来を見に行こうよ
lyrics.romaji: Mirai wo Mi ni Ikou yo
lyrics.en: Let's go see the future
lyrics.zh: 一起去看看未來吧

lyrics.ja: 止まない雨だって
lyrics.en: Even the unceasing rain
lyrics.zh: 即使是下不停的雨

lyrics.ja: 派手な向かい風だって
lyrics.en: Even a fierce headwind
lyrics.zh: 即使是猛烈的逆風

lyrics.ja: 私達を彩るスパイスだから
lyrics.romaji: Watashitachi wo Irodoru Supaisu Da kara
lyrics.en: Because they are the spices that color us
lyrics.zh: 都是為我們增添色彩的調味料

lyrics.ja: 綺麗になって　なって
lyrics.en: Become beautiful, become brighter
lyrics.zh: 讓自己變得更美，再更美

lyrics.ja: ちょびっと自信持って
lyrics.en: Have a little confidence
lyrics.zh: 擁有一點點自信

lyrics.ja: デタラメだっていいよ
lyrics.en: It's okay if it's nonsense
lyrics.zh: 就算是荒唐胡鬧也沒關係

lyrics.ja: キミと一緒に歌いたいんだよ
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to Issho ni Utaitai n Da yo
lyrics.en: I want to sing together with you
lyrics.zh: 我想和你一起歌唱啊

lyrics.ja: いつもよりも誰よりも大声で
lyrics.romaji: Itsumo yori mo Dare yori mo Oogoe de
lyrics.en: Louder than usual, louder than anyone
lyrics.zh: 比平常更大聲，比任何人都大聲

lyrics.ja: 怯まない　竦まない　魔法かけるよ　さあ
lyrics.romaji: Hirumanai Sukumanai Mahou Kakeru yo Saa
lyrics.en: I won't flinch, I won't freeze—I'll cast a spell, come on
lyrics.zh: 不退縮，不僵住，我要施展魔法囉，來吧

lyrics.ja: もっと　もっと　もっと　もっと
lyrics.en: More, more, more, more
lyrics.zh: 更多、更多、更多、更多
